$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Backup and DR Service (backupdr.googleapis.com v1). Core: core/gcp_backupdr_core.py.

gcp.backupdr.core.title: Backup vaults, backup plans, protected Compute resources, backups and restore
limitations: Vaults, plans, plan associations (instances and disks), data sources, on-demand and scheduled backups, restore and delete follow the backupdr v1 REST shapes and validations (minimum 1-day enforced retention, plan retention >= vault minimum, one plan per resource, same-region association, plan in use cannot be deleted, a backup cannot be deleted before its enforced retention ends).

A backup is a real Compute Engine snapshot of every disk of the instance (or of the disk), visible on the Snapshots page with the vyomi-backupdr label; restore creates NEW disks from those snapshots (and a new instance for an instance backup). Snapshots hold metadata only (the Compute core stores no block data), so a restored disk is the same size but empty of the original data.

Plan rules fire from a UTC schedule evaluated on every API call and by the appliance schedule pass (offline); missed fires coalesce into one backup, the first sighting of a rule only records a baseline, and a closed Nano tab runs nothing. MONTHLY/YEARLY rules are checked daily against daysOfMonth/months; weekDayOfMonth is accepted but not evaluated.

Not simulated: management servers and agent-based workloads (SAP HANA, Oracle, SQL Server, file systems), cross-region vault replication, WORM immutability beyond the enforced-retention rule, ransomware/threat insights. Long-running operations complete inline (done=true).
